mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned epithermal silver-gold project in the Aysen region, Southern Chile (330 km2 landholding; acquired Feb 2024). Historically productive mine complex: ~100 Moz AgEq mined historically; existing 500 ktpa processing facility at Laguna Verde; Taitao open pit and Laguna Verde Mine Complex. Multi-rig drilling campaign (4+ rigs) driving steady MRE growth: Feb 2026 infill drilling targeting upgrades of Inferred to Measured & Indicated to underpin restart studies. Further MRE update expected later CY2026 covering growth + infill drilling. Bonanza-grade veins extended beyond resources (Taitao East channel: 1.2 m @ 1,681 g/t AgEq (703 g/t Ag, 11.8 g/t Au); 1.2 m @ 1,178 g/t AgEq). Drilling continues to identify mineralisation well beyond resource boundaries, in some cases doubling known vertical extent. ~A$56.1M cash after Feb 2026 capital raising + SPP to fund 2026 restart studies and drilling. Chief Executive Tim Laneyrie; info@andeansilver.com; andeansilver.com.
